A '''speeder truck''',<ref name="Thrawn">[[Thrawn (novel)|''Thrawn'']]</ref> also known as a '''truckspeeder'''<ref name="Solo Official Guide">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]''</ref> '''hovertruck''' or a '''repulsortruck''', was a type of [[landspeeder]]<ref name="EG" /> that typically had extra room for cargo or storage.<ref name="Thrawn" /> The [[repulsorcraft]] was large in comparison to typical landspeeders and [[speeder bike]]s, and models included the [[A-A4B truckspeeder]] owned by [[Moloch]],<ref name="Solo Official Guide" /> as well as the [[A-A5 Speeder Truck]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="SWC">''[[Star Wars: Commander]]''</ref> Truckspeeders were known for having stronger [[Repulsorlift|antigravity generators]] than the typical landspeeder, but were lacking in acceleration.<ref name="Solo novel">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story: Expanded Edition]]''</ref>

When escaping from [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[scout trooper]]s on [[Lothal]] alongside the [[bounty hunter]] [[Bossk'wassak'Cradossk|Bossk]] with a [[speeder bike]], [[Ezra Bridger]] drove into a tunnel in the opposite direction, necessitating him to evade a sanitation repulsortruck amongst other [[repulsorlift]] vehicles. Further down the tunnel, Bridger encountered a wide and tall repulsortruck that forced him to swing his [[speeder]] close to the tunnel's ceiling to avoid being hit.<ref name="EG" />

[[Cargo speeder]]s were also repulsorlift vehicles that transported cargo.<ref name="SWEDK">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''</ref> 

{{Veh-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The speeder truck first appeared in [[canon]] in the [[2014]] junior novel ''[[Ezra's Gamble]]'', written by [[Ryder Windham]].<ref name="EG" />
